amendment_rule: This file is never edited. A change is a new file evaluation_protocol_v2.json approved through the D-100 meta-gate (propose, diff, impact analysis, replay, independent review). Results obtained under v1 keep their v1 verdict.
origin_policy: Forecast origin is the end of a calendar month; only information with a publication time on or before the origin may be used (point-in-time vintages).

targets.note: Horizon 0 is the nowcast of the current quarter, reported separately for origins in months 1, 2 and 3 of the quarter.

targets.definition: 1 if at least one month in (t, t+h] is an NBER recession month in the chronology available at evaluation time
targets.note: About eight post-war recessions: low statistical power. No ACTIVE status on scores alone; SHADOW and LIMITED_DEPLOYMENT only.

actuals.primary: first publication of the target value
actuals.secondary: value in the vintage available 12 months after the reference period
actuals.rule: Both are always reported, never pooled. T3 uses the NBER chronology as of the evaluation date.

vintages: Philadelphia Fed Real-Time Data Set for Macroeconomists
data_sources.gate: R2 acceptance: reconstruct what was known on a date t for 2000-2026; a spot check of at least 30 (series, date) pairs must match the primary-source release of that time, within rounding.

selection.use: pick the primary comparator per (target, horizon); no candidate tuning

W3.use: stress report only; contaminated by researcher and LLM knowledge of the episode

forward_registry.use: the only uncontaminated window; the start is the date of the first registry commit, no backdating

baselines.note: Atkeson-Ohanian average of the last four quarters / historical mean
factors from FRED-MD/QD, number by information criterion
Philadelphia Fed SPF median, quarterly origins only
Atlanta Fed GDPNow and NY Fed Staff Nowcast, horizon 0 only
equal-weight combination of the baselines above that apply

primary_comparator_rule: For each (target, horizon) the baseline with the lowest loss on the selection window. A candidate is also reported against every other baseline.

admission.scope: per (target, horizon) pair; a model can be ACTIVE for one pair and not for another

criteria_all_required.text: relative loss (candidate/primary comparator) <= 0.97 on W1 and on W2 separately
Giacomini-White conditional predictive ability test, HAC with h-1 lags and small-sample correction, one-sided p < 0.10 on W1 and on W2
candidate is inside the 90% Model Confidence Set against all baselines
relative loss <= 1.00 on NBER recession months of W1 and W2 (reported with the number of months; inconclusive if fewer than 12)
not significantly worse than the primary comparator on the secondary actuals
12 consecutive forward-registry months with cumulative relative loss <= 1.00 and empirical interval coverage within 10 percentage points of nominal

stages.LIMITED_DEPLOYMENT_to_ACTIVE: C6 repeated over a second, non-overlapping 12-month registry block, with no drift trigger

multiplicity.registry_of_candidates: Every candidate that was evaluated is recorded, including rejected ones; the count is part of every report.
multiplicity.control: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q = 0.10 over all candidates evaluated per (target, horizon); White Reality Check or Hansen SPA when more than 20 candidates are compared against the same comparator.

forward_registry.cadence: monthly, after the last data release of the month
forward_registry.integrity: committed to the repository before the actual value is published; rows are append-only; a correction is a new row that references the old one

drift_triggers.coverage: interval coverage outside nominal +-15 percentage points over the trailing 24 months
drift_triggers.action: SUSPENDED and review per D-101; automatic rollback only to the previous ACTIVE version
